description: Implementation of the D3D11 VertexBuffer class for ANGLE project, managing vertex buffer resources, mapping, and data storage for Direct3D 11 rendering.

classes.name: VertexBuffer11
classes.description: Class managing a Direct3D 11 vertex buffer, including initialization, mapping, data storage, and resource management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the vertex buffer with specified size and usage type.

methods.name: mapResource
methods.description: Maps the vertex buffer resource for writing.

methods.name: hintUnmapResource
methods.description: Unmaps the vertex buffer resource if it is currently mapped.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer if the new size is larger.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards current buffer contents by mapping with write discard.
